parent_objective: audit no-rollout outcome dominance localization before task-quality redesign or evaluation-panel design
blocked_by: need audit of diffuse outcome dominance before next branch decision
supersedes: direct redesign or profile comparison from M1740 localization rows

public_gates: M1741 must audit M1740 localization counts and guardrails
M1741 must classify diffuse versus localized dominance before deciding the next route
M1741 must not run environment rollout train replay PPO promote use private holdout change actor inputs tune profiles or rank controller families
M1741 must decide task-quality redesign bounded evaluation-panel design branch synthesis or stop
M1741 must preserve unsupported-feature and no-paper-claim boundaries
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat unsupported faults as covered

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits M1740 diffuse localization and decides the next task-quality route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: localization audit only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if M1740 artifacts are missing
stop if audit ranks profiles from public localization rows
stop if audit treats diffuse outcome dominance as paper-ready evidence
stop if unsupported faults are treated as covered
fallback_plan: route to task-quality redesign if dominance is diffuse
route to bounded evaluation-panel design if dominance localizes to clean slices
route to branch synthesis if another branch decision is needed before more milestones
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1740 materializes no-rollout outcome dominance localization

admission_evidence: M1740 passed localization with diffuse dominance across all scenario families and profiles
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim paper-level or level3 self-identification evidence
allowed_updates: M1741 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up route manifest if audit admits it

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; localization audit cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: audit may preserve profile controls but must not interpret localization rows as self-ID evidence
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If dominance is diffuse, record it as task-quality redesign evidence rather than self-ID failure.
allowed_claims: no rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1740 can be audited to decide whether diffuse outcome dominance requires task-quality redesign or a bounded evaluation-panel route.
success_criteria: M1740 result_class guardrails and dominant slice counts are audited
diffuse versus localized outcome dominance is classified
next route is task-quality redesign bounded evaluation-panel design branch synthesis or stop
environment rollout training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes ranking and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: audit omits M1740 dominant slice counts
audit ranks controller-family profiles from public localization rows
audit treats diffuse dominance as paper-ready evidence
environment rollout training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur
paper-level or level3 claims are made

commands.name: audit
commands.command: write outcome dominance localization result audit

decision_rule: M1741 passes if it audits localization and chooses a route without overclaiming public diagnostic rows.
